title: TypeSomething header
description: A sticky floating pill of white glass: a two-tone wordmark that types itself out, centred links with the current page as an acid pill, a language link and an acid CTA. While scrolling it slides up to the top edge and narrows; on phones a round acid button opens a menu panel.
notes: the tuck-on-scroll uses a CSS scroll timeline on the page (scroll(root)); without support it just stays floating
phone menu is a native <details>; JavaScript only drives the typing wordmark (turn it off with typing={false})
